result.answer: For x≠2, x²−4=(x−2)(x+2), so (x²−4)/(x−2)=x+2. The original quotient has domain ℝ\{2}. Although x+2 is defined for every real x and equals 4 at x=2, the original quotient is undefined there. Thus the expressions agree exactly on ℝ\{2}, but are not equivalent as functions at every real input.
